name: Bandolier
description: A bandolier: the same diagonal, with the loops for the cartridges on it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 26%, 34% 0, 100% 58%, 66% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 26%, 34% 0, 100% 58%, 66% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 26%, 34% 0, 100% 58%, 66% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 26%, 34% 0, 100% 58%, 66% 100%); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(48deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 20%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(48deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 20%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
